description: Step 1 of the content pipeline. Use when a raw filmed clip needs to enter the system — the user drops a camera file and wants a job started, says "start a new project with this clip", or "rough cut this" names a raw file that has no projects/<job>/ folder yet. Copies (never moves) the raw file into projects/<job>/raw/ and scaffolds the rest of the job folder. Job names are kebab-case titles about the CONTENT, never the camera filename.
